name: Waterbending
description: You have natural talent as a Waterbender, bending and controlling Water. Its potency scales with your attunement to Water, martial-arts skill and finesse, and energy levels. Skilled enough Waterbenders transform water into ice and heal wounds with bending, and some bend the blood of those weaker than them. Potency follows the moon: strongest at night and full moon, weaker by day.
